p53_canonical_motifs <- function(fimo_root_dir, te_bed_base_dir) {
 
  
  # Initialize results list
  results_list <- list()
  hit_list <- list()
  
  # Find all directories ending with "_fimo"
  fimo_dirs <- list.dirs(fimo_root_dir, recursive = FALSE)
  fimo_dirs <- fimo_dirs[grepl("_sea_jaspar$", basename(fimo_dirs))]
  
  for (fimo_dir in fimo_dirs) {
    base_name <- sub("_sea_jaspar$", "", basename(fimo_dir))
    
    # Find FIMO file
    sites_file <- file.path(fimo_dir, "sites.tsv")
    if (!file.exists(sites_file)) {
      message("Skipping ", fimo_dir, ": sites.tsv not found")
      next
    }
  
  
  te_file <- file.path(te_bed_base_dir, paste0(base_name, ".bed"))
    if (!file.exists(te_file)) {
      message("Skipping ", base_name, ": TE BED file not found")
      next
    }
  
    
    # ------------------------------
    # Load TE BED file
    # ------------------------------
    te_df <- read.table(te_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(te_df) <- c("chr","start","end","name","score","strand")
    te_df <- te_df[!is.na(te_df$start) & !is.na(te_df$end) & (te_df$start <= te_df$end), ]
    te_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = te_df$chr,
    ranges = IRanges(start = te_df$start, end = te_df$end),
    strand = te_df$strand,
    TE_id = te_df$name,
    TE_score = te_df$score
    )
    # ------------------------------
    # Load TP53 sites
    # ------------------------------
    cano_sites <- read.delim(sites_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    # Filter TP53 motifs
    if (!"motif_ALT_ID" %in% colnames(cano_sites)) {
      message("No motif_ALT_ID column in ", sites_file)
      next
    }
    cano_sites <- cano_sites[
      grepl("TP53", cano_sites$motif_ALT_ID, ignore.case = TRUE),
    ]
    # Skip if no motifs found
    if (nrow(cano_sites) == 0) {
      message("No TP53 motifs in ", base_name)
      results_list[[paste0(base_name, "_no_hits")]] <- data.frame(
        TE_name = base_name,
        motif_name = "TP53",
        total_TEs = length(te_gr),
        TEs_with_TP53 = 0,
        total_TP53_hits = 0,
        occupancy = 0
      )
      next
    }
    
    # Clean FIMO entries
    cano_sites <- cano_sites[!is.na(cano_sites$site_Start) & !is.na(cano_sites$site_End) & (cano_sites$site_Start <= cano_sites$site_End), ]
    
    motif_name <- unique(cano_sites$motif_ALT_ID)
    
    # Loop over each motif separately (in case multiple motifs exist)
    for (mn in motif_name) {
      fimo_motif <- cano_sites[cano_sites$motif_ALT_ID == mn, ]
      
      fimo_gr <- GRanges(
        seqnames = fimo_motif$seq_ID,
        ranges = IRanges(start = fimo_motif$site_Start, end = fimo_motif$site_End),
        strand = fimo_motif$site_Strand,
        score = fimo_motif$site_Score
      )
      
      # ------------------------------
      # Overlaps
      # ------------------------------
      hits <- findOverlaps(fimo_gr, te_gr)
      n_te_total <- length(te_gr)
      
      if (length(hits) == 0) {
        message("No overlaps for motif ", mn, " in ", base_name)
        results_list[[paste0(base_name, "_", mn)]] <- data.frame(
          TE_name = base_name,
          motif_name = mn,
          total_TEs = n_te_total,
          TEs_with_TP53 = 0,
          total_TP53_hits = 0,
          occupancy = 0
        )
        next
      }
      
      n_te_with_hits <- length(unique(subjectHits(hits)))
      n_total_hits <- length(hits)
      occupancy <- ifelse(n_te_total > 0, n_te_with_hits / n_te_total, NA)
      
    
    # ------------------------------
      # Compute relative positions
      # ------------------------------
      rel_pos <- (start(fimo_gr)[queryHits(hits)] - start(te_gr)[subjectHits(hits)]) /
                 width(te_gr)[subjectHits(hits)]
      rel_pos <- pmin(pmax(rel_pos, 0), 1)
      df <- data.frame(rel_pos = rel_pos)
      hit_df <- data.frame(
        TE_name = base_name,
       motif_name = mn,

    # which FIMO motif hit
       motif_chr = as.character(seqnames(fimo_gr)[queryHits(hits)]),
        motif_start = start(fimo_gr)[queryHits(hits)],
        motif_end = end(fimo_gr)[queryHits(hits)],
        motif_strand = as.character(strand(fimo_gr)[queryHits(hits)]),
        motif_score = mcols(fimo_gr)$score[queryHits(hits)],

    # which TE it overlaps
        TE_id = mcols(te_gr)$TE_id[subjectHits(hits)],
        TE_chr = as.character(seqnames(te_gr)[subjectHits(hits)]),
        TE_start = start(te_gr)[subjectHits(hits)],
        TE_end = end(te_gr)[subjectHits(hits)],
        TE_strand = as.character(strand(te_gr)[subjectHits(hits)]),

          rel_pos = rel_pos
        )

hit_list[[paste0(base_name, "_", mn)]] <- hit_df
      
      # ------------------------------
      # Store results
      # ------------------------------
      results_list[[paste0(base_name, "_", mn)]] <- data.frame(
        TE_name = base_name,
        motif_name = mn,
        total_TEs = n_te_total,
        TEs_with_TP53 = n_te_with_hits,
        total_TP53_hits = n_total_hits,
        occupancy = occupancy
      )
      
      # ------------------------------
      # Plot density
      # ------------------------------
      cat(paste0("### ", base_name, " ", mn, "\n"))
      cat(base_name, "| total TEs:", n_te_total, "| with cTP53:", n_te_with_hits, 
          "| hits:", n_total_hits, "\n")
      cat("Sequences with full TP53 motif: ", round(occupancy * 100, 2), "%\n\n")
      
      p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = rel_pos)) +
        geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
        labs(x = "Relative position in TE", y = "Motif density") +
        theme_classic() +
        ggtitle(paste0("canonical TP53 motif distribution: ", base_name,
                       "\nSequences with motif: ", round(occupancy * 100, 1), "%"))
      print(p)
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  } # end fimo_dirs loop
  
  # Combine all results into one data frame
  results_df <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
  
  # print(results_df)
  hits_df <- do.call(rbind, hit_list)

return(list(
  summary = results_df,
  hits = hits_df
))
}

LTR10E making of data frame

LTR10E_intermediate_data <-
  LTR10E_anno_genes %>% 
  left_join(protein_info) %>%
  left_join(Peakid_lookup_repID,by=c("repID"="repID")) %>% 
  dplyr::rename("GREAT_gene_assign"=2,
                "H3K27ac_region"=Peakid,
                "H3K27ac_region_geneId"=geneId,
                "H3K27ac_region_distanceToTSS"=distanceToTSS) %>% 
  left_join(LTR_df, by=c("repID"="RM_id")) %>% 
  mutate(my_LTR=if_else(repID %in% LTR10E_mydata, "yes","no"),
         p53_halfsite =if_else(repID %in% p53halfsite_TE_ids$Peakid, "yes","no"),
         p53_fullsite=if_else(repID %in% full_p53_canonical$TE_id,"yes","no"),
         ZNF780A_binding=if_else(repID %in%ZNF780A_overlaps_LTR10E,"yes","no"),
         ZNF680_binding=if_else(repID %in% ZNF680_overlaps_LTR10E, "yes","no")) %>% 
  left_join(set_case_list_H3K27ac,by=c("H3K27ac_region"="genes", "cluster"="cluster")) %>% 
  left_join(LTR10E_trajectory_broad,by=c("repID"="te_id", "repName"="te_name")) %>%
  mutate( sp_p53_binding=if_else(repID %in% p53_overlaps_LTR10E, "yes","no"),
         sp_CTCF_binding=if_else(repID %in% CTCF_overlaps_LTR10E, "yes","no"),
         sp_RAD21_binding=if_else(repID %in% RAD21_overlaps_LTR10E, "yes","no"),
         sp_TOP2B_binding=if_else(repID %in% TOP2B_overlaps_LTR10E, "yes","no")) %>% 

  dplyr::mutate(
    state_24T_compare = dplyr::if_else(DOX_24T == VEH_24T, "same", "different"),
    state_24R_compare = dplyr::if_else(DOX_24R == VEH_24R, "same", "different"),
    state_144R_compare = dplyr::if_else(DOX_144R == VEH_144R, "same", "different")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(overall_compare = dplyr::case_when(DOX_24T == VEH_24T & 
                                                     DOX_24R == VEH_24R &
                                                     DOX_144R == VEH_144R ~"same_all_timepoints",
                                                   TRUE ~ "different_at_one_or_more_timepoints")) %>% 
   mutate(is_DNA_repair=ENTREZID%in% DNA_repair$ENTREZID,
         overlap_DAR=if_else(repID %in% DAR_LTR10E_set,"yes","no"),
         overlap_CAR=if_else(repID %in% CAR_LTR10E_set,"yes","no")) %>% 
  left_join(phyloP_calc_df, by=c("H3K27ac_region"="Peakid","cluster"="cluster")) %>% 
  left_join(chipseeker_anno_LTR10E) %>%
  left_join(phyloP_LTR10E_df,by="repID")

Below I tested if distance to closes assigned gene was different between those that have a p53halfsite and those that don’t

ltr_tests <- LTR10E_intermediate_data %>%
  mutate(distance_to_closest=abs(closest_distance)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(
    my_LTR %in% c("yes", "no"),
    p53_halfsite %in% c("yes", "no"),
    !is.na(distance_to_closest)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(p53_halfsite) %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(
    distance_to_closest ~ my_LTR
  ) %>%
  rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p.adj")

)

plot_trajectory <- function(input_df, TE) {
  
  state_colors <- c(
  "Transcription" = "#D73027",
  "Enhancer" = "#FC8D59",
  "Poised" = "#FEE08B",
  "Repressed" = "#4575B4",
  "Quiescent" = "#D9D9D9")
  
  trajectory_cols <- c(
  "VEH_24T",
  "VEH_24R",
  "VEH_144R",
  "DOX_24T",
  "DOX_24R",
  "DOX_144R"
)

trajectory_complete <- input_df %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c( VEH_24T, VEH_24R, VEH_144R,DOX_24T, DOX_24R, DOX_144R),
    names_to = c("Condition", "Time"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "State"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(te_id, te_name, Condition),
    names_from = Time,
    values_from = State
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c( "VEH","DOX"))
  )

plot_input <-  ggplot(trajectory_complete, aes(axis1 = `24T`,
                                               axis2 = `24R`,
                                               axis3 = `144R`,
                                               y = 1)) +
     geom_alluvium(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
                   alpha = 0.4) +
     geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
                  color = "black") +
     geom_text(stat = "stratum",aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
               size = 3) +
     facet_wrap(~ Condition) +
     scale_x_discrete(limits = c("24T", "24R", "144R"),
                      expand = c(0.1, 0.05)) +
     scale_fill_manual(values = state_colors,
                       na.value = "grey80") +
     labs(title = paste0("Complete ChromHMM state trajectories for ", TE),
          x = NULL,
          y = paste0("Number of ", TE, " elements"),
          fill = "State") +
     theme_minimal()

 return(plot_input)

}
plot_trajectory_flow <- function(input_df, TE) {
  
  state_colors <- c(
    "Transcription" = "#D73027",
    "Enhancer" = "#FC8D59",
    "Poised" = "#FEE08B",
    "Repressed" = "#4575B4",
    "Quiescent" = "#D9D9D9"
  )
  
  axis_order <- c(
    
    "VEH_24T", "VEH_24R", "VEH_144R",
    "DOX_24T", "DOX_24R", "DOX_144R"
  )
  
  # ---- DOX trajectories only ----
  dox_summary <- input_df %>%
    count(DOX_24T, DOX_24R, DOX_144R, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(traj_id = paste0("DOX_", row_number()))
  
  dox_lodes <- dox_summary %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(DOX_24T, DOX_24R, DOX_144R),
      names_to = "axis",
      values_to = "state"
    ) %>%
    mutate(axis = factor(axis, levels = axis_order))
  
  # ---- VEH trajectories only ----
  veh_summary <- input_df %>%
    count(VEH_24T, VEH_24R, VEH_144R, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(traj_id = paste0("VEH_", row_number()))
  
  veh_lodes <- veh_summary %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(VEH_24T, VEH_24R, VEH_144R),
      names_to = "axis",
      values_to = "state"
    ) %>%
    mutate(axis = factor(axis, levels = axis_order))
  
  # combine for strata/text layers
  strata_df <- bind_rows(dox_lodes, veh_lodes)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # DOX flows: color each segment by the state it comes from
    geom_flow(
      data = dox_lodes,
      aes(
        x = axis,
        stratum = state,
        alluvium = traj_id,
        y = n,
        fill = state
      ),
      stat = "alluvium",
      aes.flow = "forward",
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    # VEH flows: color each segment by the state it comes from
    geom_flow(
      data = veh_lodes,
      aes(
        x = axis,
        stratum = state,
        alluvium = traj_id,
        y = n,
        fill = state
      ),
      stat = "alluvium",
      aes.flow = "forward",
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_stratum(
      data = strata_df,
      aes(
        x = axis,
        stratum = state,
        alluvium = traj_id,
        y = n,
        fill = state
      ),
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = strata_df,
      stat = "stratum",
      aes(
        x = axis,
        stratum = state,
        y = n,
        label = after_stat(stratum)
      ),
      size = 3
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits = axis_order,
      labels = c(
        "VEH 24T", "VEH 24R", "VEH 144R",
        "DOX 24T", "DOX 24R", "DOX 144R"
      ),
      expand = c(0.08, 0.05)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = state_colors,
      na.value = "grey80"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(TE, " regulatory-state trajectories"),
      x = NULL,
      y = paste0("Number of ", TE, " elements"),
      fill = "State"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

symbols <- str_to_upper(RNA_expressed$SYMBOL)

filtered_known_ltr_set3 <- known_ltr_set3 %>%
  ##create the motif-tokens column so I can keep names where there is a partial match in the RNA Symbols
  mutate(motif_tokens = str_split(str_to_upper(motif_name), "::")) %>%
  ##Because this is a list, now I need to filter using sapply, but then remove the motif token column
  filter(sapply(motif_tokens, function(x) any(x %in% symbols))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-motif_tokens)

changed from MER61E

Okay, I am going to split out the LTR10Es that are persistently active compared to those that transition to repressed state. Then I will run SEA enrichment instead of xstreme due to only using known motifs (Jaspar2024, core vetebrate non-redundant) between these elements. I will also only focus on 100+/- bp around the center of the integrant. Below is how I made the bedfiles

active_df <- what_ltr[what_ltr$active_DOX == "Active_DOX", ]
not_active_df <- what_ltr[what_ltr$active_DOX == "not_active", ]

active_names <- active_df$repID
not_active_names <- not_active_df$repID

gr_names <- mcols(MER61E_regions)$name

missing_active <- setdiff(active_names, gr_names)
missing_not_active <- setdiff(not_active_names, gr_names)

if (length(missing_active) > 0) {
  warning("These Active_DOX regions were not found in MER61E_regions:")
  print(missing_active)
}

if (length(missing_not_active) > 0) {
  warning("These not_active regions were not found in MER61E_regions:")
  print(missing_not_active)
}

active_gr <- MER61E_regions[gr_names %in% active_names]
not_active_gr <- MER61E_regions[gr_names %in% not_active_names]


# Center and resize to 100 bp
active_gr_200bp <- resize(active_gr, width = 200, fix = "center")
not_active_gr_200bp <- resize(not_active_gr, width = 200, fix = "center")

# Keep original MER61E region names as BED column 4
mcols(active_gr_200bp)$name <- mcols(active_gr)$name
mcols(not_active_gr_200bp)$name <- mcols(not_active_gr)$name

# Keep score if available
if ("score" %in% colnames(mcols(active_gr))) {
  mcols(active_gr_200bp)$score <- mcols(active_gr)$score
}

if ("score" %in% colnames(mcols(not_active_gr))) {
  mcols(not_active_gr_200bp)$score <- mcols(not_active_gr)$score
}

# Trim to chromosome bounds if seqinfo has chromosome lengths
active_gr_200bp <- trim(active_gr_200bp)
not_active_gr_200bp <- trim(not_active_gr_200bp)

# Keep only full 100 bp regions
active_gr_200bp <- active_gr_200bp[width(active_gr_200bp) == 200]
not_active_gr_200bp <- not_active_gr_200bp[width(not_active_gr_200bp) == 200]


export(active_gr_200bp, "data/Bed_exports/repeatmasker_sets/ERV1/MER61E_Active_DOX_200bp.bed", format = "BED")
export(not_active_gr_200bp, "data/Bed_exports/repeatmasker_sets/ERV1/MER61E_not_active_DOX_200bp.bed", format = "BED")

This leads me to asking if there is a relationship between length and p53 halfsites.

because there is a higher probability of randomly containing a p53 half site because the TE is longer, i want to control for it. I need to quantify number of half site/width.

what_ltr%>% 
  mutate(MYA_jukes_cantor=(-.75*log(1-4*(milliDiv/1000)/3))/(1000000*2*2.2E-9),
         MYA_bourque=milliDiv/2.2) %>% 
  mutate(age_bin=cut(MYA_jukes_cantor, breaks = 10),
         width_bin= cut(width, breaks=10),
         p53_binary=if_else(p53_halfsite=="yes",1,0)) %>% 
  group_by(age_bin, width_bin) %>% 
  summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    prop_p53 = mean(p53_binary),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n >= 5) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age_bin, y = width_bin, fill = prop_p53)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "LTR10E age bin",
    y = "LTR10E width bin",
    fill = "p53 halfsite %",
    title = "p53 halfsite enrichment across LTR10E age and width"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

There are no LTR10Es in my data that are Transition_DOX and exist in a promotor, however there are 8 LTR10E integrants that are transition DOX and are within an Intron of a gene. There are 5 that are ACtive DOX that are in an intron of a gene. This is after filtering out any LTR10Es that are Active VEH, so these represent interesting treatment specific intronic integrants.

  ggplot(., aes(x=trt_specific, y=prop,fill=p53_fullsite))+
   geom_col(position = "fill") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label =total),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(title="looking at LTR10E within clusters p53 fullsites",
    x = "Treatment specificity",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "p53 full-site"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

halfsite_summary <- what_ltr %>% 
  dplyr::filter(
    my_LTR == "yes",
    !is.na(cluster),
    p53_halfsite %in% c("yes", "no")
  ) %>% 
  group_by(cluster) %>% 
  summarise(
    yes = sum(p53_halfsite == "yes"),
    no = sum(p53_halfsite == "no"),
    total = dplyr::n(),
    prop_yes = yes / total,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

halfsite_summary
# A tibble: 3 × 5
  cluster        yes    no total prop_yes
  <chr>        <int> <int> <int>    <dbl>
1 Set_1            2     2     4    0.5  
2 Set_3           20     8    28    0.714
3 not_assigned     2     1     3    0.667
cluster_pairs <- combn(halfsite_summary$cluster, 2, simplify = FALSE)

fisher_pairwise <- map_dfr(cluster_pairs, function(pair) {
  
  test_df <- halfsite_summary %>% 
    dplyr::filter(cluster %in% pair)
  
  test_mat <- test_df %>% 
    dplyr::select(yes, no) %>% 
    as.matrix()
  
  rownames(test_mat) <- test_df$cluster
  
  fisher_result <- fisher.test(test_mat)
  
  tibble(
    cluster_1 = pair[1],
    cluster_2 = pair[2],
    p_value = fisher_result$p.value,
    odds_ratio = fisher_result$estimate
  )
}) %>% 
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

RNA_lfc_SYMBOL <-RNA_full_toptable %>% 
   dplyr::filter(SYMBOL != "NA")%>%
  dplyr::select(SYMBOL,logFC,timepoint, adj.P.Val) %>% 
  pivot_wider(., names_from = timepoint,
    values_from = c(logFC, adj.P.Val),
    names_glue = "RNA_{.value}_{timepoint}")


splitting_dox_ltr_df <- what_ltr%>% 
  dplyr::filter(my_LTR=="yes" ) %>%
   separate_rows(GREAT_gene_assign, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(
    gene = str_extract(GREAT_gene_assign, "^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+"),
    distance = str_extract(GREAT_gene_assign,"(?<=\\()[+-]?\\d+(?=\\))") %>% as.numeric(),
    direction = case_when(
      distance < 0 ~ "upstream",
      distance > 0 ~ "downstream",
      distance == 0 ~ "overlapping",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(repID,my_LTR,cluster, H3K27ac_region, H3K27ac_region_geneId, H3K27ac_region_distanceToTSS, active_DOX:direction,p53_halfsite) %>% 
  mutate(direction_range=case_when(is.na(direction)~"no_gene",
                                   abs(distance)>100000~">100kb",
                                   abs(distance)<100000 & abs(distance)>50000~"100-50kb",
                                   abs(distance)<50000 & abs(distance)>10000~ "50-10kb",
                                   abs(distance)<10000~"<10kb",
                                       TRUE~"messedup")) %>% 
  mutate(RNA_exp=if_else(gene %in% RNA_expressed$SYMBOL,"exp","not_exp"))

active_DOX_df <- 
splitting_dox_ltr_df %>% dplyr::filter(trt_specific=="active_DOX_only") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(RNA_exp=="exp")

transition_DOX_df <- 
splitting_dox_ltr_df %>% dplyr::filter(trt_specific=="transition_DOX_only") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(RNA_exp=="exp")

H3K27ac_lfc_table <- H3K27ac_toptable_list %>%

  pivot_wider(., names_from = group,
    values_from = c(logFC, adj.P.Val),
    names_glue = "{group}_{.value}" )

mcols(K9me3_gr) <-
mcols(K9me3_gr) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  left_join(
    K9me3_24T %>% dplyr::select(genes, LFC_split),
    by = c("Peakid"="genes"))


K9me3_split_gr <- split(K9me3_gr, K9me3_gr$LFC_split)
LTR10E_tad <- mergeByOverlaps(LTR10E_regions,Left_ventricle_TAD)
LTR10E_cre <- mergeByOverlaps(LTR10E_regions,SCREEN_heart_hg38_cCREs)

LTR10E_cre_df <- LTR10E_cre %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  group_by(LTR10E_regions.name) %>% 
  # dplyr::filter(LTR10E_regions.name %in% LTR10E_mydata) %>%
  left_join((SCREEN_hg38_cCREs %>% as.data.frame()), by=c("SCREEN_heart_hg38_cCREs.name" = "cCRE_ID")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(name,name.1,cCRE_class.y) %>% 
  group_by(name,cCRE_class.y) %>% tally() #%>% 
  # left_join(LTR10E_intermediate_data,by=c("name"="repID"))


LTR10E_tad <- mergeByOverlaps(LTR10E_regions,Left_ventricle_TAD)

LTR10E_tad_df <- LTR10E_tad %>%as.data.frame() %>% 
  group_by(LTR10E_regions.name) %>%tally() 
  

LTR10E_p53_pub <- mergeByOverlaps(LTR10E_regions,TP53_A549_regions)

LTR10E_tp53_df <- LTR10E_p53_pub %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  group_by(LTR10E_regions.name) %>% tally()

LTR10E_p53_hepg2 <- mergeByOverlaps(LTR10E_regions,TP53_HEPG2_regions)

LTR10E_tp53_hepg2_df <- LTR10E_p53_hepg2 %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  group_by(LTR10E_regions.name) %>% tally()

LTR10E_k9upder <- mergeByOverlaps(LTR10E_regions,K9me3_split_gr$K9_DER_up)

LTR10E_k9downder <- mergeByOverlaps(LTR10E_regions,K9me3_split_gr$K9_DER_down)

LTR10E_k9notder <- mergeByOverlaps(LTR10E_regions,K9me3_split_gr$not_DER)
lint_anno <- readRDS("data/RDS_files/LTR10E_intermediate_dataframe.RDS")


lint_anno <- lint_anno %>% 
  mutate(heart_cRE=if_else(repID %in% LTR10E_cre_df$name,"yes","no"),
          LV_TAD_overlap=if_else(repID %in% LTR10E_tad_df$LTR10E_regions.name,"yes","no"),
         TP53_A549_overlap=if_else(repID %in% LTR10E_tp53_df$LTR10E_regions.name,"yes","no"),
         TP53_HEPG2_overlap=if_else(repID %in% LTR10E_tp53_hepg2_df$LTR10E_regions.name,"yes","no"),
          LTR10E_k9notder=if_else( repID %in% LTR10E_k9notder[["name"]],"yes","no"),
         LTR10E_k9downder=if_else( repID %in% LTR10E_k9downder[["name"]],"yes","no"),
         LTR10E_k9upder=if_else( repID %in% LTR10E_k9upder[["name"]],"yes","no"))

#     theme_bw() +
#     theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,
#                                      hjust = 1))

prop_plot_LTR <- function(data, group_col, yes_no_col) {

  # Prepare data
  plot_data <- data %>%
    mutate(cluster = tidyr::replace_na(cluster, "NA"),
      cluster = factor(cluster,
        levels = c("Set_3", "Set_1", "not_assigned", "NA"))) %>%
    filter(cluster %in% c("Set_3", "Set_1", "not_assigned", "NA"))

  
  # Pairwise comparisons against Set_3
  comparison_groups <- c("Set_1", "not_assigned", "NA")

  test_results <- lapply(comparison_groups, function(g) {

    test_df <- plot_data %>%
      filter(cluster %in% c("Set_3", g))

    tab <- table(test_df$cluster,
              test_df[[rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(yes_no_col))]])

    # Check expected counts
    chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab))

    if (any(chi$expected < 5)) {
      test <- fisher.test(tab)
      method <- "Fisher"
    } else {
      test <- chi
      method <- "Chi-square"
    }

    data.frame(comparison = paste("Set_3 vs", g),
               group = g,
               p = test$p.value,
               method = method)}) %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
           label = paste0("p=", format.pval(p_adj, digits = 2, eps = 0.001)),
           y = c(1.10, 1.18, 1.26))


  # Proportions
  count_data <- plot_data %>%
    count({{ group_col }}, {{ yes_no_col }}) %>%
    group_by({{ group_col }}) %>%
    mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup()


  # Plot
  ggplot(count_data,aes(x = {{ group_col }},y = prop,
      fill = {{ yes_no_col }})) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1), "\n(n=", n, ")")),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +

    # p-values over comparison groups
    geom_text(data = test_results,aes(x = group,y = y, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              size = 3.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent,
                       limits = c(0, 1.3),
                       breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values =RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired")[3:4]) +

    labs(x = NULL,y = "Proportion") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90,
                                     hjust = 1))
}

RNA_acute_cluster <- read_excel("C:/Users/renee/Other_projects_data/DXR_data/DXR_RNA_data/Pfortmiller_S2_Appendix_251213.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Table_S6", skip = 1)

RNA_chronic_cluster <- read_excel("C:/Users/renee/Other_projects_data/DXR_data/DXR_RNA_data/Pfortmiller_S2_Appendix_251213.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Table_S7", skip = 2)

txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene

all_gene_gr <- genes(txdb)

acute_gr <-  all_gene_gr[
  names(all_gene_gr) %in% RNA_acute_cluster$Entrez_ID]
chronic_gr <-  all_gene_gr[
  names(all_gene_gr) %in% RNA_chronic_cluster$Entrez_ID]

acute_overlap <- mergeByOverlaps(acute_gr,Left_ventricle_TAD)

chronic_overlap <- mergeByOverlaps(chronic_gr,Left_ventricle_TAD)


acute_chron_TADS <-c(acute_overlap[["TAD_id"]],chronic_overlap[["TAD_id"]]) %>% 
  unique()


LTR10E_acute_chron_TAD <- LTR10E_tad %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(acuteChron= if_else(Left_ventricle_TAD.TAD_id %in% acute_chron_TADS,"yes","no")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(acuteChron=="yes") %>% 
  pull(name)

lint_anno <- lint_anno %>% 
  mutate(AC_TADs=if_else(repID %in% LTR10E_acute_chron_TAD, "yes","no"))

prop_plot_LTR(lint_anno,cluster,AC_TADs)+
  ggtitle("LTR10E that overlap a TAD with a chronic/acute gene")

lint_md_df <- lint_anno %>% 
  dplyr::select(repID,width,milliDiv,CS_distanceToTSS,p53_halfsite,ZNF780A_binding,ZNF680_binding,overlap_DAR,cluster) %>% 
  mutate(MYA_bourque=milliDiv/2.2,
         cluster=case_when(cluster=="Set_3"~1,
                           TRUE~0)) %>% 
  mutate(across(!repID, ~case_when( . == "yes"~1,
                                          . == "no"~0,
                                          TRUE ~suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))))) %>% 
  left_join(LTR10E_best_site_signal) %>%
  mutate(LTR10E.signal = if_else(is.na(LTR10E.signal), 0, LTR10E.signal),
  LTR10E.qvalue = if_else(is.na(LTR10E.qvalue), 1, LTR10E.qvalue)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!LTR10E.qvalue) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("repID") %>% 
  dplyr::select(where(~ {
      s <- sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      is.finite(s) && s > 0
    }))


lint_md_cor <- cor(lint_md_df,
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs")


Heatmap(lint_md_cor,
        column_title = "LTR10E correlation of factors",
  name = "correlation",)

lint_t_cor <- cor(t(lint_md_df),
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs")


Heatmap(lint_t_cor,
        column_title = "LTR10E correlation of Integrants",

  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 4))
